tc.research_text.technom:DYNAMO: Making magic energy out of magic energy.
technom.research_page.CONDENSER.1: Too much power is never a bad thing, and now you've got a machine to put it to good use. By hooking up an Energy Condenser to some conduits, you can turn Forge Energy (Q) into some Potentia. The Potentia can then easily be piped out of the condenser into your favorite jar. The energy cost of one Potentia is set by the condenserCostQ config value (200,000 Q by default).
technom.research_page.DYNAMO.1: After studying the way the Arcane Bore and Infernal Furnace draw essentia for power, you've decided to make your own spinoff using Forge Energy. By hooking the Essentia Dynamo to a series of pipes and wires, you can take essentia and turn it into Forge Energy (Q). Some aspects carry more energy than others and last longer, producing more power. How the Essentia Dynamo answers a redstone signal can be reconfigured in place.
technom.research_page.DYNAMO.2: Right clicking on the Dynamo with a Redstone Torch will cause the Dynamo to be disabled by a redstone signal, Gunpowder will make it ignore redstone, and Redstone Dust will return it to its original behavior. The dynamo can be rotated using most wrenches.
technom.research_page.DYNAMO.4: You have also discovered that Dynamos can have their power output increased at the cost of fuel consumption. By right clicking on the Dynamo with a Potency Gem, the Dynamo will output four times the power, but will also consume four times the fuel. Shift Right clicking on the Dynamo with an empty hand will remove the Potency Gem.
technom.research_page.QUANTUMJARS.1: You have discovered a way to use the power of the almighty science to cram more essentia into a jar. This new jar uses quantum mechanics to increase its maximum storage capacity and therefore can be a bit unstable. The quantum jar is a bit more intelligent and has a higher suction rate than unlabeled warded jars and its suction increases depending on the amount of essentia within it.
technom.research_page.TECHNOBASICS.1: After a series of scientific discoveries, you've figured out ways to incorporate your pre-existing electronics into your new magical discoveries unlocking some new basic materials.
block.technom.node_dynamo.rate: %s Q/t from Vis drained out of aura nodes within %s blocks
block.technom.node_dynamo.per_vis: One Vis is worth %s fuel points, scaled by essentiaFuelScale
technom.research_page.NODEDYNAMO.1: Continuing your research into magical energy, you have realised that the vis of a node is not unlike the essentia held in items. A Node Dynamo drains one vis at a time from aura nodes and jarred nodes within four blocks, never taking the last point of an aspect, and burns it into Forge Energy through its output face. Its redstone behaviour, potency gem and rotation work exactly as on the Essentia Dynamo.
technom.research_page.ROD_electric.1: Infusing a normal silverwood wand core with some energy and machines gives it special properties at the cost of its vis storage. With any Forge Energy battery in your inventory, the wand draws energy from it to refill its own vis storage at 100 Q per centivis, that is 10000 Q for one whole vis of a primal aspect. This wand can store 25 vis of each primal.
tc.research_text.technom:TECHNOTURGESCEP: The right tool for every job!
technom.research_page.TECHNOTURGESCEPTER: After struggling with the low storage of the Energized Wand, you have started experimenting with ways to increase this capacity. No matter what you try, you always end up with a rod which is too big for normal use as a wand. But now that you have mastered scepters, you realise these failed experiments would make a perfect scepter core! The Technoturges Scepter holds 150 vis of each primal and recharges from a wand recharge pedestal or from any Forge Energy source, at 100 Q per centivis.

Assembly is Thaumcraft's own scepter recipe: three identical wand caps, a thaumic charm and the Technoturges core, which also means it needs the Scepters research. The scepter counts as a wrench on Technomancy machines; the 1.7.10 version's wrench support for other mods and its block-rotation gestures are not part of this port.
